featured_reviews.name: Roshni Mukeri
featured_reviews.review_text: I visited the store to browse and explore gift options, but the experience was quite unpleasant. One of the staff members kept following us continuously while we were just looking around, which made us very uncomfortable. The behavior felt intrusive and unnecessary. The constant presence, nosiness, and expressions made the visit awkward instead of welcoming. Customers should be allowed to browse freely without feeling watched or judged. I hope this feedback is taken seriously and staff are guided on maintaining appropriate customer space.

featured_reviews.name: Michal Chintadi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I went to the Archies shop in Mira Road to buy gifts, and after going there I was looking around at the items. While I was moving around, the staff kept walking right behind me. Wherever I went, they were following me. Being a customer, anyone would feel uncomfortable if three staff members are surrounding you while you’re shopping.

I asked them why they were standing around me like that, and one lady there got annoyed and rudely said, “You need help, that’s why.” I replied, “Yes, if I need help, I will ask for it, but if three staff members keep surrounding me, it becomes uncomfortable.”

Honestly, I had a very bad experience. Whatever the situation, customers should be given their own space, not constantly shadowed by staff—especially not three of them together. It was really very uncomfortable, and because of that I lost interest in buying anything. So, I just bought one small item and left the place.

I request the Archies shop owner to train your staff in proper customer service.

featured_reviews.name: Bhavesh Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting a Unique gift shop in Virar, and I must say, it was an absolute delight! From the moment I stepped inside, I was transported into a wonderland of unique treasures and delightful surprises.

The first thing that caught my eye was the beautifully curated displays. Every corner of the shop was filled with carefully arranged items that seemed to whisper stories of their own. The attention to detail was impeccable, and it created an inviting and whimsical atmosphere.

One of the standout features of this gift shop was its wide range of merchandise. Whether you're searching for a small trinket or a meaningful keepsake, this place has it all. From handcrafted jewelry to locally made ceramics, from quirky stationery to elegant home decor, there was something to suit every taste and occasion. It was a true haven for those seeking unique and one-of-a-kind gifts.

What truly set this gift shop apart was the impeccable customer service. The staff members were friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about their products. They were more than happy to assist me in finding the perfect gift, offering insightful suggestions and even sharing the stories behind some of the items. Their personalized approach made the shopping experience truly memorable.

Furthermore, the prices were reasonable considering the quality and uniqueness of the products. It was refreshing to see that the gift shop catered to a wide range of budgets, ensuring that everyone could find something special without breaking the bank.

Lastly, the gift shop also had an online presence, which made it convenient for those who couldn't visit in person. The website was user-friendly and offered a comprehensive overview of the products available. Additionally, they provided secure packaging and prompt delivery, ensuring that the gifts reached their recipients in perfect condition.

In conclusion, this gift shop is a hidden gem that deserves to be discovered. Its enchanting ambiance, diverse selection of unique gifts, exceptional customer service, and convenient online presence make it a standout destination for any occasion. I highly recommend paying a visit to this delightful wonderland—you won't be disappointed!
